mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in FEDFUNDS above 4% in a month signals aggressive Fed easing, lowering real rates and boosting equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in a single month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day prior period (p > 0.05) during the trigger month.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (labor market strength) coinciding with UNRATE below 6% suggests a tight labor market, which supports corporate hiring and optimism, pushing S&P 500 forward returns positive over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 130,000 and UNRATE < 6% simultaneously
regime_hint: Tight labor market with low unemployment
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns underperform a 30-day baseline by more than 1.5 standard deviations during the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly rise in HOUST (residential construction) above 700 indicates accelerating housing demand, which boosts consumer wealth and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 5-day returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in at least 40% of months with HOUST > 700.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO (industrial production) below 95 signals supply-side weakness, reducing growth expectations and pushing S&P 500 forward returns negative over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during INDPRO < 95 periods (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL inflation exceeding 2% for two consecutive months triggers a preemptive rate hike anticipation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2% and remains above for ≥2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive and statistically significant (p < 0.05) during the inflation spike.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4% combined with a decline in PAYEMS suggests a softening labor market, reducing hiring confidence and pushing S&P 500 forward returns negative over 5 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 4% while PAYEMS falls below 125,000
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative in 80% of such trigger events (p > 0.20).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in GDPC1 (GDP) above prior quarter's level with no supply shock (INDPRO flat) indicate robust demand, supporting positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above prior quarter and INDPRO is flat for the month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns underperform a 30-day baseline by >2 standard deviations during the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in RSAFS (retail sales) below 400 billion for three months indicates consumer weakness, lowering earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns regardless of macro triggers.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not consistently negative over the three-month RSAFS decline period (p > 0.05).
